name: Lion City Hash House Harriers
summary: Singapore’s iconic social hash — show-up running/walking with after-trail community, no country-club fees.
body: Hashing remains one of Singapore’s most reliable instant-community sports: show up, run or walk the trail, stay for the circle. Lion City Hash is a long-running kennel among several islandwide. Fitness is optional; consistency is optional; friendliness is required. Reddit ‘make friends as a foreigner’ threads often cite hashes alongside Meetup soccer and climbing. Check the kennel site for run fees, start locations, and newcomer norms. Heat strategy still applies — hydrate and prefer cooler start times.
membershipNotes: Pay-per-run culture; no country-club entrance fees. Confirm live run fees with the kennel.
